name: cloudflare-diagram
title: CloudflareDiagram
description: Cloudflare's services on a Diagram: each a node with what it can call and receive as ports, from a catalog generated from Cloudflare's docs, Wrangler's schema and the Workers types. A connection can only be one the catalog says there is, and it offers the real methods. What it's given is a system, which saves as JSON and reads from and writes to wrangler.jsonc, or is read from a workerd config.capnp: it says what's wrong with one, and with editable a search of the catalog adds a service and a service's machine opens in a StateDiagram. Read-only by default. No Cloudflare artwork. ELK and XState are optional peers.
